# Infusion Bizz

> Jaipur-based PR and media agency providing press release distribution, corporate PR, and media coverage for brands, founders, and public figures across India.

## Pages
- [Home](https://infusionbizz.com/): Services including press release distribution, press conferences, news page features, meme marketing, podcasts, and influencer collaborations.
- [Our Work](https://infusionbizz.com/our-work): Featured media placements and press coverage across lifestyle, fashion, F&B, beauty, business, and entertainment.
